verdict.rationale: Railway documents automatic WebSocket handling and regional deployment for its services, but the evidence never describes edge or serverless functions. WebSocket support on long-running services is an adjacent capability, not persistent WebSockets from within edge/serverless functions. A cloud provider could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
